RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of discrimination; panel composition typically reflects existing departmental leadership or HR staff. At the director level, hiring decisions often prioritize stakeholder communication, political acumen, and interview performance over technical credentials or years of service. Her strong background in public consultation likely aligned with the municipality's current priorities.

Raising sex discrimination without concrete proof will appear combative, damage your professional reputation, and jeopardize future opportunities in the sector. Two weeks is also a standard administrative turnaround time for written debriefs. Instead, follow up politely to request constructive feedback focused on interview scoring and how you can strengthen future executive applications.
